keyDeserializer.title: Key deserializer class
keyDeserializer.description: Java class used by ConsoleConsumer to decode keys; leave empty for the Kafka CLI default.

valueDeserializer.title: Value deserializer class
valueDeserializer.description: Java class used by ConsoleConsumer to decode values; leave empty for the Kafka CLI default.

keySerializer.title: Key serializer class
keySerializer.description: Java class used by ConsoleProducer to encode keys; leave empty for the Kafka CLI default.

valueSerializer.title: Value serializer class
valueSerializer.description: Java class used by ConsoleProducer to encode values; leave empty for the Kafka CLI default.

extraClasspath.title: Extra Java classpath
extraClasspath.description: Jars/directories appended to -cp for custom (de)serializers; use ':' on Linux/macOS or ';' on Windows.
